topic: bgfx Handle System and Resource Management
extracted_claim: bgfx uses typed handles with idx (uint16_t) and type (uint16_t). Handle::Enum lists: DynamicIndexBuffer, DynamicVertexBuffer, FrameBuffer, IndexBuffer, IndirectBuffer, OcclusionQuery, Program, Shader, Texture, Uniform, VertexBuffer, VertexLayout. IMPLEMENT_HANDLE macro generates template specializations. BGFX_CHECK_HANDLE validates handle against HandleAlloc. HandleAlloc provides pool allocation with max handles tracking. Release template specializations free Memory via g_allocator.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no handle system. bgfx's typed handle pattern is the standard for GPU resource management.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE has raw GL resource IDs

topic: bgfx Command Buffer and Render Pipeline
extracted_claim: bgfx uses CommandBuffer for deferred GPU commands: RendererInit, Create* (VertexLayout, IndexBuffer, VertexBuffer, Dynamic*, Shader, Program, Texture, FrameBuffer, Uniform), Destroy*, Update*, ReadTexture. Commands serialized with alignment. SortKey encodes draw/compute ordering by view, program, depth, blend, alpha-ref. PredefinedUniforms: ViewRect, ViewTexel, View, InvView, Proj, InvProj, ViewProj, InvViewProj, Model, ModelView, InvModelView, ModelViewProj, AlphaRef, IndirectArgBase. FrameArenaT provides per-frame memory allocation with block allocation and mutex-free access.
implementation_relevance: HSE draws directly. bgfx's command buffer pattern separates CPU submission from GPU execution.

extracted_claim: bgfx supports MULTITHREADED mode with BGFX_MUTEX_SCOPE for thread-safe command submission. Renderer backends: Noop, AGC, Direct3D 11, Direct3D 12, GNM, Metal, NVN, Vulkan, WebGPU, OpenGL 2.1-4.6, OpenGL ES 2.0-3.2. BGFX_PROFILER_SCOPE/BEGIN/END for instrumentation. PlatformData for native window handles. g_platformDataChangedSinceReset for context recreation. TinyStlAllocator for custom STL allocators. TextVideoMem for debug text rendering.
implementation_relevance: HSE only supports OpenGL. bgfx shows how to abstract across 10+ graphics APIs.
